highlights: Google's latest TPU innovations promise advanced long-context and confidential AI inference, signaling a hardware push to support more complex and secure AI deployments.
The AI agent ecosystem is maturing with new tools for persistent behavioral learning and agent-specific Git servers, enabling more robust and manageable autonomous systems.
Major companies like OpenAI and Google are releasing new frontier models and specialized AI for critical domains such as cybersecurity, alongside strategic acquisitions to bolster developer tooling.

agents.title: Decision Context: Persistent Behavioral Learning for AI Agents
agents.summary: This research introduces 'Decision Context,' a system that enables AI agents to persistently learn from human corrections and tool-call failures across sessions, compiling behavioral signals into executable rules for enhanced long-term autonomy.

agents.title: Baidu’s ERNIE Evolve Automated Research System Beats NanoChat and NanoGPT Records
agents.summary: Baidu's ERNIE Evolve is an automated research system that streamlines AI development by editing code, running experiments, and retaining only verified gains, demonstrating significant speedups in model inference and research efficiency.

agents.title: Memory-Aware Multi-Agent Architecture with LLM-based Orchestration for Conversational Recommendation
agents.summary: This work proposes a memory-aware multi-agent architecture for conversational recommender systems, leveraging LLMs for orchestration to integrate long-term memory and enhance user intent capture, improving interaction flow and output quality.

models.title: Google Unveils TPU 8i Max and TPU 8tx: A Dual-Chip TPU and a Confidential TPU
models.summary: Google has announced new eighth-generation TPUs: the TPU 8i Max, featuring two TPU 8i chips for long-context AI agents, and the TPU 8tx, which integrates hardware-level confidential inference capabilities for enhanced security.

models.title: Gemini 4 Argon: Built to solve your hardest problems
models.summary: Google has released Gemini 4 Argon, their latest frontier model, providing developers, enterprises, scientists, and consumers with access to cutting-edge AI capabilities designed for tackling complex challenges.

models.title: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
models.summary: OpenAI introduces GPT‑6 Cyber, a specialized cybersecurity model trained to identify exploitable vulnerabilities and develop fixes within authorized scopes, pushing the frontier of aligned AI agents in security applications.

tools.title: Buoyant Releases Kinference: An Open Source Inference Control Plane for Kubernetes and vLLM
tools.summary: Buoyant has open-sourced Kinference, an Apache 2.0 inference control plane for vLLM on Kubernetes, providing declarative routing, KV-cache-aware load balancing, and per-tenant metrics to significantly reduce LLM inference latency.

tools.title: Reason Machines Open-Sources Aspen, a Git Server Built for AI Agents
tools.summary: Reason Machines has open-sourced Aspen, a self-hosted Git server specifically designed for AI agents, following OpenAI’s Pando design to support high-throughput operations like 567 pushes per second on a single server.

tools.title: 0sec Labs Open-Sources 0, an AI Security Harness With Web UI, CLI and MCP
tools.summary: 0sec Labs has released '0,' an open-source AI security harness that runs locally with your chosen model provider, offering capabilities for code review, pentesting, reverse engineering, and automated fixes via a web UI, CLI, or MCP server.

companies.title: ChatGPT Enterprise now available in AWS Marketplace
companies.summary: ChatGPT Enterprise is now accessible via AWS Marketplace, streamlining procurement for organizations by allowing them to leverage existing AWS purchasing and billing relationships for OpenAI's enterprise-grade AI solution.

companies.title: OpenAI to acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc.
companies.summary: OpenAI is set to acquire Pierre Computer Company, Inc., a strategic move aimed at expanding and enhancing Codex's developer tools for building, understanding, and reviewing code, signifying a focus on core software development infrastructure.

companies.title: CodeRabbit scales agentic software development and ships 20x more
companies.summary: CodeRabbit successfully leverages OpenAI models to manage and trust AI-generated code, enabling their engineering team to ship 20 times more software, demonstrating a significant leap in productivity through agentic software development.

learning.title: MoE Routing Strategies Explained: Top-K, Expert-Choice, Sigmoid Gating and Dynamic Routing (2026 Guide)
learning.summary: This comprehensive guide explains seven Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) routing strategies, detailing how models like Mixtral and DeepSeek-V4 assign tokens to experts, providing essential knowledge for optimizing LLM architectures.

learning.title: How to Run NVIDIA Dory 4B with llama.cpp: Loop by Loop Guide
learning.summary: This coding guide offers a detailed, loop-by-loop walkthrough for running NVIDIA's Dory 1.0 4B looped language model using llama.cpp, covering build processes, compute cost analysis, memory caching tests, and paired evaluations.

learning.title: Australian universities are creating AI-native graduates
learning.summary: Australian universities are actively integrating AI into their curricula and expanding access to ChatGPT for students, aiming to cultivate 'AI-native' graduates prepared for the evolving AI-enabled workforce.
